# Project: gh-600 lab (Python stock indicator library)

## Coding standards
- Python 3.2 type hints on every function.
- Tests use pytest and live in /tests and mirroring /src paths.
- No new third-party dependencies without why in the PR description. 

## Boundaries 
- Never modify files under /config.
- Never commit secrets, API keys, or .env files.

## Output expectations
- Every change must include or update tests.
- PR descriptions must list: what changed, why, how it has tested.
